# Objective
This document reports on the **differential abundance analysis** of the R1 experiment performed in the Fall of 2023 (completed Dec 2023) and R2 experiment performed in the Spring of 2024 (completed spring/summer 2024). Data represents the output of Miseq (R1) and NextSeq (R2) sequencing run of the Tri5 Mutant Microbiome project (Guixia Hao & Briana K. Whitaker & Nick Rhoades). 


```{r PRELOAD, echo=FALSE, results='hide', include=FALSE} 
x<-c("ggplot2", "phyloseq", "DESeq2",  "tidyr", "dplyr", "ggVennDiagram", "Biostrings",
     "reshape2", "ComplexHeatmap")
lapply(x, require, character.only = TRUE)

#Load functions
source("./code/multiplot.function.R")
#add 'not in' function
`%nin%` = Negate(`%in%`)
# geometric mean
gm_mean_protected <- function(x) {
  if (all(x == 0)) {
    return (0)
  }
  exp(mean(log(x[x != 0])))
}

#set seed
set.seed(555)

# set ggplot2 theme
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size=11)) 
theme_update(panel.grid.major=element_line(0), panel.grid.minor=element_line(0))

# color palettes
strain_col <- c("#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#1B9E77")
```

# DESeq base model
* note - that the design matrix is only used in estimating dispersion & log2fold changes, but not sizeFactors
* Create DESeq2 datasets for MAIN EFFECTS (no interaction terms)
* See DESeq2 vignette for explanation of why including interaction terms alters interpretation of main effects (justification for doing 2 separate models: main effects only and interactions only)

```{r, results = 'hide', fig.width =4, fig.height = 4}
dds_r2b <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(ps_r2b, ~ 1)   #no model for now
dds_r2b_main <- DESeqDataSet(dds_r2b, ~ Strain + Chamber.Rep)
dds_r2b_main <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_r2b_main,
              geoMeans = apply(counts(dds_r2b_main), 1, gm_mean_protected))
#FILTERING STEP
    nc <- counts(dds_r2b_main, normalized = FALSE)
    filter <- rowSums(nc >= 2) >= 6 # 6 is half the reps per treatment combo
    table(filter)
    dds_r2b_main <- dds_r2b_main[filter,]
# END FILTERING STEP
dds_r2b_main <- DESeq(dds_r2b_main, test="Wald", fitType="local") #embedded dispersion estimates
plotDispEsts(dds_r2b_main)
```
* If we filter out taxa that do not have at least 2 reads across each of 6 samples
    * r1b 20/136 taxa
    * r1f 5/35 taxa **don't filter, too few taxa
    * r2b 28/641 taxa
    * r2f 39/249 taxa

### Adjust p-values again for multiple comparisons
* For each ASV, there is a p-value for each contrast between each pair of Main effects 
* the P-value for each of these contrasts has already been corrected for multiple comparisons (i.e., 1 test for each ASV)
* To get the "effect-level" p-values, adjust again for multiple comparisons within each Term (i.e., 1 test for each pairwise group contrast within each Term)
* This correction asks whether all of the log2 fold changes between group pairs are simultaneously nonzero
* Here, the 'strain' term has potentially 3 total #s of comparisons for each strain-strain comparison, so we need to correct for those 3 #s of independent hypotheses.

```{r}
# ## version where no filtering of taxa was done during creation of deseq2 objects
# #write.csv(l2fc, "./data/Tri5MB_deseq_mainEffects_contrasts.csv")
# l2fc <- read.csv("./data/Tri5MB_deseq_mainEffects_contrasts-edit.csv", 
#                  row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = TRUE) #manually add b or f to the ASV column

# #version where YES filtering of taxa was done during creation of deseq2 objects
#write.csv(l2fc, "./data/Tri5MB_deseq_mainEffects_contrasts_filtered.csv")
l2fc <- read.csv("./data/Tri5MB_deseq_mainEffects_contrasts_filtered-edit.csv", 
                 row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = TRUE) #manually add b or f to the ASV column

group_by(l2fc, RepKing, Term, Taxon) %>% 
    mutate(padjadj = p.adjust(padj, method='BH')) %>% 
    ungroup %>% as.data.frame -> l2fc

table(l2fc$padj <= 0.05)  
table(l2fc$padjadj <= 0.05) # after additional correction

table(l2fc$padjadj <= 0.05 & l2fc$log2FoldChange >= 2)  #signif & >=2 fold change
```

### Notes for MS
```{r}
# median fold change, use abs() for magnitude not direction
# use (2^) to back-transform from log2fold changes to just fold change
# only look at significant enrichments/depletions

# median log2 fold change (no back transform)
l2fc %>% 
  filter(significant == "Significant") %>%
  group_by(Contrast) %>% 
  summarize(medianFC = median(abs(log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup %>% as.data.frame -> medianlogFCs
medianlogFCs # this is the log2 fold change

l2fc %>% filter(significant == "Significant") %>% droplevels -> l2fc_signif

table(l2fc_signif$RepKing)
table(l2fc_signif$class)
length(table(l2fc_signif$ASV))
#table(l2fc_signif$RepKing, l2fc_signif$log2FoldChange>0, l2fc_signif$Contrast) 
table(l2fc_signif$log2FoldChange>0, l2fc_signif$Contrast) 

```
* log2 fold-change: positive values indicate enrichment in 1st listed strain in the contrast, whereas negative values indicate enrichment the 2nd listed strain.


# Figures


### Bar Plot
```{r, results = 'hide', echo = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9}
taxa_col <- c("#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#E7298A", "#7570B3", "#377EB8", "#66A61E", "#E6AB02", "#A6761D")

# subset & organize df for bar plot
out <- l2fc_signif %>% filter(RepKing!="r1f") %>% droplevels
sub <- out
sub$class <- as.factor(sub$class)
levels(sub$class)[1] <- "Unk_Ascomycota"
sub$class <- factor(sub$class, 
    levels = c("Actinobacteria", "Alphaproteobacteria", "Bacilli", "Gammaproteobacteria",
               "Unk_Ascomycota","Dothideomycetes", "Sordariomycetes", "Ustilaginomycetes"))
levels(sub$RepKing)[1] <- "R1-Bacteria"
levels(sub$RepKing)[2] <- "R2-Bacteria"
levels(sub$RepKing)[3] <- "R2-Fungi"
# "log2 fold-change: positive values indicate enrichment in 1st listed strain in the contrast, whereas negative values indicate enrichment the 2nd listed strain."
levels(sub$Contrast)[1] <- "<-- Control : PH1 -->" # so need to reverse the listing order to match how plot is read
levels(sub$Contrast)[2] <- "<-- Tri5 : PH1 -->"
levels(sub$Contrast)[3] <- "<-- Control : Tri5 -->"

b0 <- ggplot(sub, 
       aes(x = simple_name, y = log2FoldChange, fill = class)) + 
    facet_grid(RepKing~Contrast, scales = "free", space = "free") +
    coord_flip() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour="gray50", linewidth=1, linetype = 2) +
    geom_col(width = 0.9, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, preserve = "single") ) +
    scale_x_discrete("") +
    scale_y_continuous( expression(paste("Log"[2], " Fold Change")) , breaks = c(-20, -10, 0, 10, 20)) +
    scale_fill_manual("", values = taxa_col) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.byrow = TRUE)
#tiff("./figures/BarPlot_all.tiff", width=8, height=7, units="in", res=300)
b0
#dev.off()

```

# Heatmap
```{r}
out %>% 
    mutate(Var = paste(Contrast, RepKing, sep = "-")) %>% 
    select(Var, simple_name, log2FoldChange) -> out2 #RepKing, 
# create wide format
sub_w <- dcast(out2, simple_name ~ Var, value.var = "log2FoldChange", 
               drop = FALSE, fill = 0)
rownames(sub_w) <- sub_w$simple_name
sub_w %>% select(-simple_name) %>% as.matrix() -> sub_w

sub_dist <- cor(sub_w, method = 'pearson')
sub_clust <- hclust(as.dist(sub_dist), method = "ward.D2")

par(mfrow = c(1,1)); plot(sub_clust)

#require(gclus)
#sub_clust_k2 <- kmeans(sub_clust, centers = 3, nstart = 1000, iter.max = 10)

Heatmap(sub_w, 
        show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
        row_dend_reorder = TRUE,
        clustering_distance_rows = "pearson",
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2")
        #cluster_columns = FALSE)

Heatmap(sub_w, 
        show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = TRUE, 
        row_dend_reorder = TRUE,
        clustering_distance_rows = "pearson",
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        cluster_columns = FALSE)
```
